items.title: 2026 Toyota Fortuner Leader Edition Launch Price Rs 36.51 Lakh
items.summary: Available in 4x2 manual and automatic variants, the updated Leader Edition retains its familiar exterior styling while adding ambient lighting. Bookings open on October 12. The post 2026 Toyota Fortuner Leader Edition Launch Price Rs 36.51 Lakh appeared first on RushLane .
